# Loose-Notes

> Loose-Notes pulls the audio recordings, PDFs and images out of GoodNotes `.goodnotes` files. It runs entirely in
> the browser; nothing is uploaded.

Drop in one notebook or several and you get back what's inside, grouped by notebook, ready to download one by one
or as a zip. A `.goodnotes` file is a zip archive; the page reads it with JSZip and works out what each attachment
is from its first bytes: M4A recordings, PDFs, and JPEG, PNG, HEIC, GIF or WebP images.

## Using it

1. In GoodNotes, open the notebook, tap Share, then Export as GoodNotes.
2. Drop the `.goodnotes` file onto the page, or click to choose it. Several at once is fine.
3. Click a file's name to preview it, use the download button on its row, or press Download all for one zip.
